payload.rebuttal: fixed: Same root cause as finding 1, and fixed by the same change. I added the batch-handler check inside `test_a_cell_sent_sigterm_tears_down_and_closes_its_task` itself rather than as a separate test, because a standalone batch-only test was already rejected once by the `revert` gate as theater: `batch`'s dispatch is unchanged by this diff by design, so a test exercising only `batch` can never fail when `saffron/cli.py` is reverted to base. Folding the check into the existing witness keeps it revert-sensitive, since that test already fails on its `cell`-side assertions when reverted. Verified by hand: applying the exact wrong-version edit quoted in this finding (wrapping `batch` in the full sigtermed/`_on_sigterm`/finally guard) now fails this same assertion.
